payload.rebuttal: fixed: test_a_rebuttal_the_cap_cut_reads_as_out_of_budget_not_as_silence never covered a REBUT whose rebuttal and extraction turns both succeed but whose combined cost happens to reach or pass REBUT_CAP_USD, with no commit and only a claimed fix. I added that case (costs 6.00 and 4.50, rebut_commits=0, extracted=_CLAIMED_FIX) and assert the task stays REBUTTING with the old 'moved no commit and made no argument' wording, not the cap's out-of-budget line. Verified this fails against the exact mutant (cap.spent >= cap.cap in place of cap.refused), which wrongly rewrote the line to 'REBUT ran out of its $10.00 budget' even though nothing was refused.
